sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的外面是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能几乎每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用一个不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我热爱一锅端食谱，因为我讨厌洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，持续助您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，在 nytimes.com 斜杠 subscribe 享受优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittroff.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗夫，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On Wednesday morning, after an eight-week trial whose every turn has grabbed headlines, a jury found Sean Combs, the music mogul known as Diddy,
sentences.zh: 周三上午，经过了一场备受瞩目、历时八周的审判后，陪审团裁定音乐大亨肖恩·库姆斯（即人称的Diddy）

sentences.en: not guilty of the most serious charges against him.
sentences.zh: 对其面临的最严重指控不成立。

sentences.en: Today, I speak with Ben Cesario about why the prosecution's case fell short at trial.
sentences.zh: 今天，我与本·切萨里奥谈论了为什么控方的案件在审判中未能如愿。

sentences.en: And Jody Cantor on what the verdict may tell us about how prosecutors and juries see sexual abuse cases.
sentences.zh: 还有乔迪·坎托谈论这一裁决可能向我们揭示了检察官和陪审团如何看待性虐待案件。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, July 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月3日，星期四。

sentences.en: Ben, hi.
sentences.zh: 本，你好。

sentences.en: Thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你来到这里。

sentences.en: Are you outside the courthouse right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在在法院外面吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm right around the corner from the federal courthouse downtown.
sentences.zh: 对，我就在市中心联邦法院的拐角处。

sentences.en: Okay, well, we'll try not to take up too much of your time, but very happy to have you here.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我们尽量不占用你太多时间，但非常高兴你能来。

sentences.en: As we know, since we did an episode on this with you last week,
sentences.zh: 如我们所知，因为我们上周刚和你做过一期关于这事的节目，

sentences.en: Diddy has been on trial for the last two months or so facing sex trafficking and racketeering charges.
sentences.zh: Diddy在过去两个月左右的时间里一直面临性贩运和有组织犯罪指控的审判。

sentences.en: These are accusations that centered on the argument that he had coerced two ex-girlfriends into repeated sex sessions with multiple men.
sentences.zh: 这些指控的核心论点是他曾胁迫两名前女友与多名男性多次发生性关系。

sentences.en: The jury started its deliberations on Monday, and you were at the courthouse today when the verdict was announced.
sentences.zh: 陪审团周一开始审议，而你今天在法院宣读裁决时就在现场。

sentences.en: So tell me how it unfolded.
sentences.zh: 所以告诉我整个过程是如何展开的。

sentences.en: Well, it started like most mornings, where there's a long line of people to get into the courthouse.
sentences.zh: 嗯，开始时和大多数早晨一样，法院外排着长长的安检队伍。

sentences.en: There's all the reporters, but then there's influencers and just members of the public who have been showing up every day at this point after two months.
sentences.zh: 有所有的记者，然后还有在两个月后的今天每天都来报到的网红和普通公众。

sentences.en: You know, I recognize a lot of them, and we say good morning to each other, and we head inside the court building.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我认得他们中的许多人，我们互相道一声早安，然后走进法院大楼。

sentences.en: There was a real sense of tension about this because we've all been waiting for the verdict for two months now.
sentences.zh: 这里有一种非常紧张的氛围，因为我们大家都在等了两个月后等待裁决结果。

sentences.en: But the other thing is that on Tuesday, the jury told the judge that they had reached a verdict on four of the five counts against Sean Combs,
sentences.zh: 但另一件事是，周二时陪审团告诉法官，他们已经对肖恩·库姆斯的五项罪名中的四项达成了裁决，

sentences.en: but they were still deadlocked on the fifth one, which is the racketeering conspiracy charge.
sentences.zh: 但他们在第五项罪名——有组织犯罪共谋指控上仍然陷入僵局。

sentences.en: Since they said that, I think everybody has been trying to game out in their minds how this day might go.
sentences.zh: 自从他们这么说以后，我想每个人都在心里推演今天会怎么发展。

sentences.en: So what happened when things started today?
sentences.zh: 那么今天事情开始时发生了什么？

sentences.en: It started off pretty normal.
sentences.zh: 一开始相当正常。

sentences.en: The jury was deliberating.
sentences.zh: 陪审团在进行审议。

sentences.en: And then a little later in the morning, a note was delivered.
sentences.zh: 接着在稍早的上午，递出了一张字条。

sentences.en: And word got around that the jury had reached a verdict.
sentences.zh: 消息传开，陪审团已经达成裁决。

sentences.en: So Sean Combs comes in.
sentences.zh: 于是肖恩·库姆斯走了进来。

sentences.en: He's accompanied by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 陪同他的是美国

sentences.en: Marshals, who have brought him in every day of the trial.
sentences.zh: 法警，他们带他出席了审判的每一天。

sentences.en: And he gets to his seat, looks to his family, who are seated right in the front of the public gallery, and he mouths to them, we got this.
sentences.zh: 他走到座位上，看着坐在旁听席最前排的家人，对他们做口型说：我们稳了。

sentences.en: And he has a copy with him of the 11th Psalm, which is the one that begins, in the Lord, I take refuge.
sentences.zh: 随身携带了一本《诗篇》第11篇，也就是以“我在耶和华那里避难”开头的那一章。

sentences.en: It's about putting your trust in God.
sentences.zh: 这是关于将信任寄托在上帝身上。

sentences.en: The jury comes in, and the foreperson is called on by the judge to read their verdict.
sentences.zh: 陪审团进场，法官点名首席陪审员宣读裁决。

sentences.en: And the first count that's read is racketeering conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 宣读的第一项罪名是有组织犯罪共谋。

sentences.en: This is one of the most serious charges he was facing.
sentences.zh: 这是他面临的最严重指控之一。

sentences.en: It carries a potential life sentence.
sentences.zh: 最高可判处无期徒刑。

sentences.en: It's also one of the trickiest ones for the government to prove.
sentences.zh: 这也是政府最难证明的指控之一。

sentences.en: It's a very complicated law.
sentences.zh: 这是一项非常复杂的法律。

sentences.en: And the verdict was not guilty.
sentences.zh: 裁决结果是无罪。

sentences.en: And you could see the release on Sean Combs, the feeling of relief that he has been found not guilty of this very serious charge.
sentences.zh: 你能看到肖恩·库姆斯的解脱，他被判定没有犯下这项非常严重的罪名后感到的轻松。

sentences.en: It's a big moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个重大时刻。

sentences.en: Big moment.
sentences.zh: 重大时刻。

sentences.en: Very dramatic moment in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 法庭里非常戏剧性的时刻。

sentences.en: And then they get to the second count, which is sex trafficking of Cassie.
sentences.zh: 然后他们来到了第二项罪名，即对卡西的性贩运。

sentences.en: Cassie, his ex-girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 卡西，他的前女友。

sentences.en: Cassie, his ex-girlfriend who got this entire thing started when she filed a lawsuit against him a year and a half ago.
sentences.zh: 卡西，他的前女友，也就是一年半前对起诉他提起诉讼从而引发这一切的人。

sentences.en: And she was definitely the star witness in the trial.
sentences.zh: 她绝对是这次审判中的明星证人。

sentences.en: She was on the stand for four days giving pretty grueling testimony about her experience with Combs.
sentences.zh: 她出庭作证了四天，提供了关于她与库姆斯经历的相当折磨人的证词。

sentences.en: But the jury found that Sean Combs was not guilty of sex trafficking of her.
sentences.zh: 但陪审团裁定肖恩·库姆斯对她的性贩运罪名不成立。

sentences.en: So two wins right off the bat for him.
sentences.zh: 所以他一开局就赢了两场。

sentences.en: The next count that they read was transportation to engage in prostitution related to Cassie's story.
sentences.zh: 他们宣读的下一项罪名是与卡西事件相关的运送从事卖淫活动。

sentences.en: This is also known as the Mann Act.
sentences.zh: 这也称为曼恩法案。

sentences.en: It's a law that says it's illegal to transport people across state lines for the purpose of prostitution.
sentences.zh: 这是一项规定为了卖淫目的跨越州界运送人员属于非法的法律。

sentences.en: And it was guilty.
sentences.zh: 结果是有罪。

sentences.en: So now he's been found guilty of one charge, but not of two others.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他被判定一项罪名成立，但另外两项不成立。

sentences.en: Okay, what about the rest?
sentences.zh: 好的，那其余的呢？

sentences.en: So the next one is sex trafficking of a woman known as Jane.
sentences.zh: 接下来是对一名被称为简的女性的性贩运。

sentences.en: This is an anonymous woman who was Combs' girlfriend after Cassie.
sentences.zh: 这是一名匿名女性，她是卡西之后库姆斯的红颜知己。

sentences.en: And she told, in some ways, a very similar story to Cassie about being coerced into these long sex marathons with prostitutes, but not guilty.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，她讲述了一个与卡西非常相似的故事，关于被胁迫参与这些与妓女一起的长达数小时的性爱马拉松，但罪名不成立。

sentences.en: And the fifth and last count that was read was another transportation to engage in prostitution, this time related to Jane, and it was guilty for that one.
sentences.zh: 宣读的第五项也是最后一项罪名是另一项运送从事卖淫活动，这次与简有关，这项被判有罪。

sentences.en: So just to sum up here, Ben, he's found not guilty of these two really serious charges, racketeering and sex trafficking, in the case of both of these former girlfriends.
sentences.zh: 所以总结一下，本，在这两位前女友的案件中，他被裁定这两项非常严重的罪名——有组织犯罪和性贩运不成立。

sentences.en: But he is found guilty of this lesser charge, which is essentially hiring a sex worker.
sentences.zh: 但他被判定犯下了这项较轻的罪名，本质上是雇佣性工作者。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: He was acquitted of, by far, the most serious charges, the ones that could have landed him life in prison, and that the government had really built its entire case around.
sentences.zh: 他被判无罪的远罪名是最严重的，那些可能让他面临终身监禁、并且政府围绕其构建了整个案件的罪名。

sentences.en: He still was found guilty of two counts of a federal crime, but the sentence is a lot lower, and the crime itself is regarded as far less serious
sentences.zh: 他仍然被判定犯有两项联邦犯罪，但刑期要低得多，而且犯罪本身被认为远没有那么严重

sentences.en: than racketeering and sex trafficking.
sentences.zh: 相比于有组织犯罪和性贩运。

sentences.en: The family, who have been in court almost every day, and some supporters behind them, were in just jubilation when the not guilty verdicts were read,
sentences.zh: 几乎每天都出庭的家属以及他们身后的一些支持者，在宣读无罪裁决时欣喜若狂，

sentences.en: cheering, clapping, holding their arms up in the air.
sentences.zh: 欢呼、鼓掌、高举双臂。

sentences.en: And it sounds like Diddy and his team are viewing this as a huge win, just based on their reaction.
sentences.zh: 听起来Diddy和他的团队从他们的反应来看，将此视为一场巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: Short of a full acquittal, this was the best outcome he could have hoped for.
sentences.zh: 除了解除所有罪名之外，这是他所能期望的最好结果。

sentences.en: You know, the body language from him was, like, utterly different than we had seen even just the day before, when he seemed quite worried about the way this might all play out.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的肢体语言与甚至就在前一天相比完全不同，当时他似乎对这一切可能如何收场感到相当担忧。

sentences.en: And he thanked the jury as they filed out of the room.
sentences.zh: 当他们鱼贯离开房间时，他向陪审团表示了感谢。

sentences.en: And there was just this sort of palpable relief from him.
sentences.zh: 并且他身上有一种显而易见的解脱感。

sentences.en: His lawyers were all smiling.
sentences.zh: 他的律师们都在微笑。

sentences.en: And the prosecutors who are seated at the table in front of them, who represent the federal government, were looking straight ahead, stone-faced.
sentences.zh: 而坐在他们面前桌子旁代表联邦政府的检察官们则目视前方，面无表情。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I want to walk through the two big buckets of charges that he was found not guilty of.
sentences.zh: 我想过一遍他被判无罪的这两大类指控。

sentences.en: First, let's talk about what we said the last time that we talked was always going to be the more complicated of the two charges, which is racketeering conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们来谈谈我们上次谈话时所说的两项指控中永远更复杂的那一个，即有组织犯罪共谋。

sentences.en: The prosecution here, as you told us, needed to prove that Diddy had a network of employees who were all actively helping him commit these crimes.
sentences.zh: 正如你告诉我们的，这里的控方需要证明Diddy拥有一个由员工组成的网络，他们都在积极协助他实施这些犯罪。

sentences.en: Why do you think the jury didn't buy the prosecution's argument?
sentences.zh: 你认为为什么陪审团不买账控方的论点？

sentences.en: Well, we can't read their minds, and we haven't heard from any of the jurors yet.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们无法看穿他们的心思，而且我们还没有听到任何陪审员的发言。

sentences.en: But I think that the government maybe just didn't persuade them that this machine that Sean Combs had of assistants and bodyguards and all these people who worked for him,
sentences.zh: 但我认为政府可能只是没能说服他们，肖恩·库姆斯拥有的这台由助理、保镖和所有为他工作的人组成的机器，

sentences.en: even if it was a perfectly well-oiled machine, that its purpose was committing crimes.
sentences.zh: 即使它是一台运转良好的机器，其目的也是为了犯罪。

sentences.en: That the employees knew, if they're conspirators, then it means that they knew that they were engaged in something illegal.
sentences.zh: 这些员工知道，如果他们是共谋，那就意味着他们知道自己参与了非法的事情。

sentences.en: There was conflicting testimony about what the assistants did know about these sexual encounters, which were called freak-offs at the trial,
sentences.zh: 关于助理对审判中被称为“疯狂派对”（freak-offs）的这些性爱遭遇到底了解多少，存在着相互矛盾的证词，

sentences.en: whether they knew what was happening in the room or they didn't know what was happening in the room.
sentences.zh: 他们是知道房间里发生了什么还是不知道房间里发生了什么。

sentences.en: Right, yes.
sentences.zh: 对的，没错。

sentences.en: I mean, there were these questions about whether these were accomplices or just employees doing a job who didn't actually know what they were participating in effectively.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，存在这些疑问：这些人是共犯，还是只是在做一份工作的员工，实际上并不知道他们参与了什么。

sentences.en: I think that was certainly the defense's position, that the government hadn't proved that.
sentences.zh: 我认为这绝对是辩方的立场，即政府尚未证明这一点。

sentences.en: The government argued very strongly, but I think when it came to the jury, they just didn't buy it.
sentences.zh: 政府辩论得非常有力，但我认为到了陪审团那里，他们就是不买账。

sentences.en: Okay, now let's turn to the second charge, which by comparison seemed more straightforward, the sex trafficking charge.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在我们转向第二项指控，相比之下它看起来更直接，即性贩运指控。

sentences.en: The prosecution argued that these two former girlfriends were essentially forced into these freak-offs.
sentences.zh: 控方辩称这两名前女友基本上是被迫参加这些疯狂派对的。

sentences.en: It seems as though the jury, though, was more persuaded by the defense's position, which is that the girlfriends were willing participants in these encounters.
sentences.zh: 然而，看起来陪审团对辩方的立场更买账，即这些女友是这些遭遇的自愿参与者。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Either that or that they just didn't believe beyond a reasonable doubt that they were coerced.
sentences.zh: 要么是这样，要么就是他们没有确凿证据相信她们是被胁迫的。

sentences.en: Maybe they bought the defense's position fully.
sentences.zh: 也许他们完全接受了辩方的立场。

sentences.en: Maybe they just didn't feel persuaded by the story that the government told that these women were coerced, even just in certain instances over the course of the long relationships
sentences.zh: 也许他们只是觉得政府讲述的故事——即这些女性在长期恋爱关系的某些阶段是被胁迫的——没有说服力

sentences.en: that Holmes had with these women.
sentences.zh: 霍尔姆斯与这些女性的关系。

sentences.en: He was with Cassie for over a decade, and the government actually said, we're not arguing that every single time they did this, it was coerced.
sentences.zh: 他和卡西在一起十多年了，而政府实际上说过，我们并不认为他们每次这样做都是被胁迫的。

sentences.en: But we are saying that it happens sometimes, and they pointed to a few particular episodes of that.
sentences.zh: 但我们是在说有时确实会发生，并且他们指出了其中的几个特定情节。

sentences.en: And just to remind folks who may not have been following this as closely as you were, the jury was adjudicating that question of were they coerced into this or not
sentences.zh: 顺便提醒一下那些可能没有像你一样紧密关注此事的人，陪审团是在裁决她们是否被迫参与其中这个问题

sentences.en: based on a huge body of text messages, right, that these women had with Diddy that was presented at trial.
sentences.zh: 根据在审判中展示的这些女性与Diddy之间的大量短信，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, there was also a testimony from the two women who had the longest time on the stand of any witness.
sentences.zh: 嗯，还有两位证人的证词，她们在证人席上的时间比任何其他证人都长。

sentences.en: Cassie was on the stand for four days.
sentences.zh: 卡西在证人席上待了四天。

sentences.en: Jane was on the stand for six days.
sentences.zh: 简在证人席上待了六天。

sentences.en: And they told very gripping, upsetting stories about the things that had happened in their relationship.
sentences.zh: 她们讲述了引人入胜且令人不安的故事，关于她们恋爱关系中发生的事情。

sentences.en: But the defense's strategy was to undermine them with those text messages.
sentences.zh: 但辩方的策略是用那些短信来削弱她们的可信度。

sentences.en: And there were hundreds of them that they presented at court where they would make flirtatious comments to Combs, where they would get involved with the planning
sentences.zh: 他们在法庭上出示了数百条短信，在这些短信中她们对库姆斯发表调情言论，参与策划

sentences.en: and even the choosing of which male escorts were going to be invited.
sentences.zh: 甚至挑选要邀请哪些男男性伴侣。

sentences.en: And I think that that really complicated the story that the government was trying to tell.
sentences.zh: 我认为这确实使政府试图讲述的故事变得复杂化。

sentences.en: And that may have been the reason that the jury found him not guilty.
sentences.zh: 这可能就是陪审团裁定他无罪的原因。

sentences.en: The government's response was that these women were telling Diddy what he wanted to hear, right?
sentences.zh: 政府的回应是，这些女性只是在对Diddy说他想听的话，对吗？

sentences.en: That they were in a scenario in which they felt they had to say they were happy about this, but they weren't really.
sentences.zh: 她们处于一种认为自己必须说对此感到高兴但实际上并非如此的境地。

sentences.en: I mean, the women said that themselves.

sentences.en: And after the verdict was announced, the government released a statement where they basically defended their work and they talked about prosecuting sex crimes
sentences.zh: 裁决宣布后，政府发表了一份声明，基本上是在为他们的工作辩护，并谈到了起诉性犯罪

sentences.en: requires brave victims to come forward.

sentences.zh: 你一直关注着他的案件在纽约重审重回法庭的过程。

sentences.en: You've also just generally been a student of sexual assault litigation in the wake of Me Too.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，你也是“我也是”运动后性侵诉讼的研究者。

sentences.en: So I wanted to talk to you to help interpret this verdict.
sentences.zh: 所以我找你是想请你帮帮忙，来解读这一裁决。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.en: They are often very hard to prove.

sentences.en: And it's also a premise of our legal system that we would rather have a guilty person walking around free than we would send an innocent person to prison.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们法律系统的一个前提，即我们宁愿让一个有罪的人逍遥法外，也不愿把一个无辜的人送进监狱。

sentences.en: So the starting assumption,
sentences.zh: 所以最初的假设，

sentences.en: I think for most sex crime trials, is that it's very hard to convict.
sentences.zh: 我认为对于大多数性犯罪审判来说，定罪都非常困难。

sentences.en: But the question for the legal system in the wake of the Me Too movement has been, is it too hard?
sentences.zh: 但在“我也是”运动之后，法律系统面临的问题一直是：是不是太难了？

sentences.en: Is the system so rigid that it can't recognize reality when a crime has taken place?

sentences.en: Can it not recognize what is sometimes the messy nature of these interactions and of women's lives?
sentences.zh: 它难道无法认清这些互动以及女性生活中有时存在的混乱本质吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: One of the central questions that came in the aftermath of the Me Too movement seemed to be, how are all of these accusations that have been made in the public square,
sentences.zh: “我也是”运动之后出现的核心问题之一似乎是：所有这些在公开场合提出的指控，

sentences.en: how do they translate to a court of law, right?
sentences.zh: 它们将如何在法庭上转化，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, how are judges and juries going to handle the complexity and mushiness of cases that hinge on questions of consent?
sentences.zh: 比如，法官和陪审团将如何处理那些取决于同意问题的案件的复杂性和模糊性？

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: So here's a really messy thing that both the recent Weinstein trial in New York and the Diddy trial have in common, which is that some of the women at the center of these cases
sentences.zh: 所以这里有一个非常混乱的情况，纽约最近的韦恩斯坦案和迪迪案都有这个共同点，那就是这些案件核心的一些女性

sentences.en: acknowledged having had somewhat romantic, somewhat consensual relationships with the accused.
sentences.zh: 承认与被告有过某种程度的浪漫、某种程度自愿的关系。

sentences.en: It is so hard for a jury of strangers to walk into one of these rooms, take a look at this very private thing that happened in the past and say, ooh, you know,
sentences.zh: 对于由陌生人组成的陪审团来说，走进其中一间屋子，审视过去发生的这种极度私密的事情，然后说，噢，你知道的，

sentences.en: I can draw a clear line between, you know, what is consensual and what is non-consensual here.
sentences.zh: 我可以在这里明确划清什么是自愿的，什么是非自愿的。

sentences.en: Will a jury decisively,
sentences.zh: 陪审团会果断地、

sentences.en: unanimously be willing to say, yes, this man is guilty and in the Diddy case, send him to federal prison for a really long time based on a relationship that's hard to parse?
sentences.zh: 一致地愿意说，是的，这个人有罪，并且在迪迪案中，根据一段很难剖析的关系，把他送进联邦监狱很长时间吗？

sentences.en: That was a problem for prosecutors in both trials.
sentences.zh: 这在两次审判中都是检察官的一个难题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in this case, while we don't know everything that the jury was thinking, it seems clear that they felt unable to say definitively these two women didn't consent
sentences.zh: 在本案中，虽然我们不知道陪审团的所有想法，但显而易见的是，他们觉得无法明确表示这两位女性没有同意

sentences.en: to these sexual encounters.

sentences.zh: 就像是，陪审团在说，我们是局外人，在决定这是否自愿。

sentences.en: I mean, making that kind of determination just has to be difficult, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，做出那种判定肯定很难，对吧？

sentences.en: It's really difficult.
sentences.zh: 真的很难。

sentences.en: And part of what prosecutors did in both cases is that they used somewhat creative techniques.
sentences.zh: 两次审判中检察官所做的事情之一，就是他们使用了某种富有创造性的技巧。

sentences.en: Like, in the first Weinstein trial in New York, the one that was overturned, the prosecutors brought these other women in who were kind of pattern witnesses who testified about
sentences.zh: 比如，在纽约的第一次韦恩斯坦审判中，也就是被推翻的那次，检察官找来了其他一些女性作为某种模式证人，她们作证

sentences.zh: 韦恩斯坦对她们的行为。

sentences.en: And it was both very effective in the courtroom.

sentences.en: And it was also the reason why the conviction was overturned by a very narrow margin because it struck some of the appellate judges as unfair.
sentences.zh: 这也是定罪被极微弱优势推翻的原因，因为这让一些上诉法官觉得不公平。

sentences.en: There's like a bedrock principle in the legal world that you can only be tried for the thing you're being tried for.

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.en: With Diddy, what you see is this kind of creative prosecution that involves sex trafficking charges and racketeering, even though in so many ways what this looks like
sentences.zh: 而在迪迪案中，你看到的是这种涉及性贩运指控和敲诈勒索的富有创造性的起诉，尽管在很多方面，这看起来

sentences.en: is maybe a little more similar to a domestic violence case.
sentences.zh: 可能更类似于家暴案件。

sentences.zh: 所以，我们刚才讨论了系统有多么死板。

sentences.zh: 这是检察官试图让系统不那么死板，并寻找新方法来证明这种行为是犯罪。

sentences.en: But as they're doing that, what you're telling us is that you kind of make what could be a straightforward charge into a much more complex case that may be harder to prove.
sentences.zh: 但当他们这样做时，你告诉我们的是，你把原本可能很直接的指控变成了一个更复杂的案件，可能更难证明。

sentences.en: Look, these are both cases about extremely powerful men who are alleged to have used their power to victimize women.
sentences.zh: 听着，这两个案件都涉及极其权势熏天的男性，据称他们利用权力将女性受害。

sentences.en: And the criminal justice system doesn't have a straightforward way of measuring that.
sentences.zh: 而刑事司法系统没有直接的方法来衡量这一点。

sentences.en: And both of these cases involved the really difficult question of, like, what exactly is coercion?
sentences.zh: 这两起案件都涉及一个极其棘手的问题，即到底什么是胁迫？

sentences.en: And prosecutors, in constructing these much more elaborate cases, which in this instance included, you know, racketeering, are trying, it seems, to illustrate that power,
sentences.zh: 而检察官在构建这些更为复杂的案件时（本案中包括敲诈勒索），似乎试图阐明这种权力，

sentences.zh: 把它勾勒出来，展示它是如何运作的，他们说，这是为了服务于这些犯罪。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: They're trying to bring to legal life these terrible power dynamics that the women experienced.
sentences.zh: 他们试图将女性经历的这些可怕的权力动态带入法律的现实中。

sentences.en: And crucially, they're trying to say that these power dynamics aren't just unfortunate, but that they were deployed in a criminal way.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，他们试图说明这些权力动态不仅是不幸的，而且它们是以犯罪的方式被部署的。

sentences.en: And that's not an argument we would have seen a generation or two ago.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们在上一代或两代人之前会看到的辩论。

sentences.en: It isn't that long ago that prosecutors really would not touch cases like this that involved consensual sex because the conventional wisdom among prosecutors were that juries
sentences.zh: 就在不久前，检察官真的不会碰这种涉及自愿性行为的案件，因为检察官的传统共识是，陪审团

sentences.zh: 会觉得这太混乱了。

sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这两个案件截然不同的结果如此有趣，对吧？

sentences.zh: 陪审团有时采纳了有时又没有采纳检察官的论点。

sentences.zh: 在韦恩斯坦重审中，该审判的核心有三名女性。

sentences.en: And then on the third, he was convicted.

sentences.en: And then with
sentences.zh: 然后对于

sentences.en: So in both trials, you sort of get the sense that the message from the jury is we're not cool about what happened.
sentences.zh: 所以在两次审判中，你都会有一种感觉，来自陪审团的信息是，我们对发生的事情感到很不舒服。

sentences.en: There was some criminality here.
sentences.zh: 这里确实存在某种犯罪行为。

sentences.en: There's something seriously wrong, but we are
sentences.zh: 有些事情出了严重的问题，但我们

sentences.zh: 也不愿意完全接受所有的指控。

sentences.en: What do you make of that, this mixed result?
sentences.zh: 你如何看待这种复杂的混合结果？

sentences.en: In this case, also in the
sentences.zh: 在本案中，还有在

sentences.zh: 韦恩斯坦案中，这说明了什么？

sentences.en: It's funny,
sentences.zh: 真有趣，

sentences.en: Natalie.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉。

sentences.en: I've spent years telling people, don't draw broad conclusions from one legal proceeding.
sentences.zh: 我花了多年时间告诉人们，不要从一个法律诉讼中得出宽泛的结论。

sentences.en: You can't judge the entire Me

sentences.zh: 迪迪结合起来时，我们确实拥有了一个很好的晴雨表，可以看出人们现在是如何思考的，对吧？

sentences.en: Because there is willingness willingness to recognize the women's stories and to say that something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 因为人们愿意承认女性的故事并说有些事情是不对的。

sentences.en: There is a desire on the part of prosecutors to better reflect the reality of what women have experienced.
sentences.zh: 检察官有一种愿望，想要更好地反映女性所经历的现实。

sentences.en: And yet, there's also a lot of debate and reluctance.
sentences.zh: 然而，这也伴随着大量的辩论和不情愿。

sentences.zh: 所以鉴于围绕着

sentences.zh: “我也是”运动和这些议题的所有思潮，祝你好运，能让这么多人就此达成一致。

sentences.en: Right.
